clue.text: Parties before returning favourite skirt

parts.note: sides are the parties or factions in a dispute

indicators.note: returning means the word for favourite is read backwards, coming back the other way

parts.note: a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet

explanation.surface: Parties held before a favourite skirt comes back into fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns PET into TEP. 'skirt' is a verb here, not a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: To skirt a problem is to avoid it, the same as dodging it by stepping aside.

clue.text: Join up at last, cutting share

indicators.note: cutting means that letter cuts into the word for share

parts.note: a slice is a share, as in a slice of the profits

indicators.note: at last takes the final letter of up

explanation.surface: Couples finally unite, splitting the profits.
explanation.definitionFit: To splice ropes or film is to join them end to end.

clue.text: London or Cardiff must hold record of this vital medical authorisation

indicators.note: must hold says the words London or Cardiff contain the answer within them

explanation.surface: Both capitals should keep records of this life-saving consent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'record of this' links the definition: the card itself is a record.
explanation.definitionFit: A card carried to authorise use of one's organs for transplant after death.

clue.text: Philosophy classes held here?

definitions.meaning: a way of thinking held by a group, a doctrine
read literally, a place where lessons on thinking are taught

explanation.surface: Are lessons in philosophy given in this place?
explanation.definitionFit: A body of opinion shared by a group is a philosophy, and literally an academy for reasoning.

clue.text: A part that's rubbed out by age, of course

parts.note: an era is an age
sure means of course, certainly

explanation.surface: A section fades away with age, naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: A deletion, the place where something has been rubbed away.

clue.text: Wishes to dispose of one house that's much admired

indicators.note: to dispose of means a letter is thrown away from the wishes word

parts.note: desires are wishes
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone wishes to get rid of one property everybody covets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to dispose of' drops the I from DESIRES. DES RES is estate-agent shorthand for 'desirable residence'.
explanation.definitionFit: Estate-agent slang for a desirable residence, a home that buyers would envy.

clue.text: Current employer confined to bed

parts.note: something that employs electric current and stays in bed, not a boss who is ill

explanation.surface: My present boss is laid up in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current employer' reads as one's present boss, but it means a user of electric current.
explanation.definitionFit: A heated bedcover powered by mains electricity, kept on the mattress.

clue.text: Paper encompassing student's sphere of knowledge

indicators.note: encompassing means the paper quantity surrounds the learner

parts.note: a ream is a quantity of paper, 500 sheets
L is a learner, a student

explanation.surface: A student's essay covers their field of study.
explanation.definitionFit: A domain or field, as in the realm of science.

clue.text: Reserve hotel centrally located in coast

indicators.note: located in places that letter within the word for coast

parts.note: the seaside is the coast

indicators.note: centrally picks the middle letter of hotel

explanation.surface: Book a hotel right in the middle of the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: To put something aside for later use is to keep it in reserve.

clue.text: Sudden rushes of spring tides missing one day

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring

indicators.note: missing means those two letters are absent from tides

parts.note: taken as the word tides
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Floods of spring tides fail to arrive one day.
explanation.definitionFit: Floods or sudden outpourings, as in a spate of complaints.

clue.text: Meal set up without no end of hoo-ha

indicators.note: without means the following letter is left out of the word for set up

parts.note: to launch a business is to set it up

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of hoo-ha

explanation.surface: A meal is prepared with no fuss at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes the A that ends 'hoo-ha' from LAUNCH; 'no' merely stresses the absence.
explanation.definitionFit: The midday meal, eaten between breakfast and dinner.

clue.text: Java programme pictures something to eat

parts.note: an applet is a small program written in the Java language
pictures are art

explanation.surface: A computer program produces images of food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Java' tempts toward coffee or the island, but it is the programming language.
explanation.definitionFit: A fruit pastry dessert is plainly an edible item.

clue.text: Limo work with student in snub for religion?

parts.note: a limousine is a car
a machine that works is said to go

indicators.note: in places the learner inside the word for snub

parts.note: to cut someone is to snub them
L is a learner, a student driver

explanation.surface: A chauffeur job with a learner driver in it is ignored for some faith.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a cargo cult is a religion only loosely, a belief system in Melanesia centred on Western goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A cargo cult is a Pacific islands belief movement expecting goods from ancestral spirits, a kind of faith.

clue.text: Occasions for millions breaking links

indicators.note: breaking means the abbreviation splits the word for links apart

parts.note: ties are links or bonds

explanation.surface: On occasion millions of people cut their connections.
explanation.definitionFit: Separate instances, as in 'several times', are occasions.

clue.text: Aluminium found in blood, in abundance

indicators.note: found in means the symbol sits inside the word for blood

parts.note: gore is spilt blood
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

explanation.surface: Traces of a metal are detected in great quantity in a blood sample.
explanation.definitionFit: Plentiful, aplenty: the word always follows its noun, like 'in abundance'.

clue.text: Dispatch, incorporating list for salary

indicators.note: incorporating means the word for dispatch takes the other word inside it

parts.note: to dispatch is to send
to list is to lean or tip over, as a ship does

explanation.surface: A payment is sent along with an itemised list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'list' is not a catalogue but a ship's lean, TIP.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixed regular payment, as to a clergyman, is a salary.

clue.text: Too thin after a diet came out?

indicators.note: out means the letters of a diet came are put out of order

explanation.surface: After dieting, someone emerged excessively skinny.
explanation.definitionFit: Abnormally thin and wasted, especially from illness or starvation.

clue.text: Obvious harangue in support of female prisoner

indicators.note: in support of means in a down answer this piece sits beneath the female prisoner

parts.note: a lag is a convict
to rant is to harangue

explanation.surface: A clear tirade backing a woman in jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'LAG' is British slang for a convict, usually 'old lag'.
explanation.definitionFit: Flagrant means glaringly evident, conspicuously offensive.

clue.text: Party girl dunking digestive vacantly in coffee

indicators.note: in places those letters inside the coffee

parts.note: a latte is milky coffee

indicators.note: vacantly empties the word digestive, keeping only its outer letters

explanation.surface: A young woman dips a biscuit into her coffee.
explanation.walkthrough: A digestive is a plain British biscuit, here emptied to DE.
explanation.definitionFit: A young woman who drinks and behaves boisterously, a female counterpart of the lad.

clue.text: Electronic circuits with energy run out

parts.note: laps are circuits of a track
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Electronic circuits lose power as the energy runs down.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that passes or expires has run out, as a lease does.

clue.text: Where the road is always up?

definitions.text: Where the road is always up?

parts.words: Where the road is always up?
parts.note: road is up in Britain means roadworks, but here the road simply runs overhead an underground passage

explanation.surface: Which place has permanent roadworks?
explanation.walkthrough: 'The road is up' is British for roadworks; in a pedestrian underpass the road is literally above you.
explanation.definitionFit: An underpass for walkers beneath a road, so the road is always overhead.

clue.text: Charge for accommodating men in theatre

indicators.note: in places the soldiers inside the word for theatre

parts.note: the stage stands for theatre
OR, other ranks, are soldiers, the men

explanation.surface: A fee for housing actors at a playhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: OR (other ranks) is the military term for ordinary soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A fee paid for keeping goods in a warehouse is a storage charge.

clue.text: Makes slow progress at home, with game unfinished

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: unfinished drops the final letter of the game

parts.note: chess is a board game

explanation.surface: Someone slowly advances while playing a game at home they never finish.
explanation.definitionFit: To move forward by tiny steps, little by little.

clue.text: Blow last of pimento making relish

parts.note: a gust is a blow of wind

indicators.note: last of takes the final letter of pimento

explanation.surface: A puff of wind carries a bit of pepper into a relish.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto is keen enjoyment, the same as doing something with relish.

clue.text: Tired nation has left for the second time

indicators.note: for the second time says the second T of the nation word is replaced by left

parts.note: a state is a nation

explanation.surface: A weary country departs once again.
explanation.walkthrough: The trick is reading 'for' as 'replacing': L goes in place of the second T.
explanation.definitionFit: Stale means jaded or tired, as in stale old ideas.

clue.text: A speech about Germany and love

indicators.note: about means the A and speech wrap round the code

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: Someone gives a speech about Germany and romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep devoted love or worship, as in gazing with adoration.

clue.text: The lack of feeling of alcoholics accepting leasing arrangement

indicators.note: accepting means the two A's take the shuffled letters between them

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous

indicators.note: arrangement means the letters of leasing are rearranged

explanation.surface: A support group agrees to a property lease that leaves them numb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alcoholics' is the crossword shorthand for Alcoholics Anonymous; the reshuffled letters of 'leasing' sit between its two A's, and 'The' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The medical term for insensibility to pain, a loss of sensation.

clue.text: Don't start drawing this sailing vessel

indicators.note: Don't start tells you to drop the opening letter of the word for drawing

parts.note: a sketch is a drawing

explanation.surface: An artist is told not to begin drawing a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-masted fore-and-aft rigged boat is a type of sailing vessel.

clue.text: Scoff in effort to get peace agreement

indicators.note: in places the word for scoff inside the attempt

parts.note: a try is an effort or attempt
to scoff is to eat greedily

explanation.surface: Someone mocks the attempt to secure a peace deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scoff' suggests mockery, but it is British slang for eating.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal pact between nations ending hostilities.

clue.text: Change, despite including phosphorus molecules

indicators.note: including attaches the symbol to the shuffled letters

parts.note: P is the chemical symbol for phosphorus

indicators.note: Change means the letters of despite are rearranged

explanation.surface: A modification is made despite the inclusion of an element.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' looks like a noun opening the sentence, but it is the signal to rearrange 'despite'; 'including' simply adds the phosphorus symbol at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Short chains of amino acids, compounds of the kind biochemists study.
